theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_graph_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) → ∀ (c : Rn n) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (q '' graphOver f (closedBall c r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
